title: Part 7: Dreams of Psychotherapy's Past, And It's Future

sentences.en: The first dream that we have on record was dreamed by a woman, and her name was Aduduri, and she was the overseer of the palace of Mari in Mesopotamia.
sentences.zh: 我们有记载以来的第一个梦是由一个名叫阿杜杜里的女人梦到的，她是美索不达米亚马里王宫的女管家。

sentences.en: More than 3,000 years ago, she etched a letter onto clay tablets describing what she saw.
sentences.zh: 3000多年前，她在泥板上刻下一封信，描述了她所看到的景象。

sentences.en: In my dream, I had gone into the temple of the goddess Belit-el-Akim, and the statue of Belit-e-Kalim wasn't there, nor were
sentences.zh: 在梦中，我走进了贝利特-埃尔-阿基姆女神的神庙，贝利特-埃尔-阿基姆的雕像不在那里，

sentences.en: the statues of the other divinities that normally stand beside her.
sentences.zh: 通常陪伴在她身边的其他神灵的雕像也不在了。

sentences.en: Faced with this sight, I wept and wept.
sentences.zh: 面对这样的景象，我痛哭流涕。

sentences.en: George Steiner observed something profound about this dream.
sentences.zh: 乔治·斯坦纳对这个梦做出了一番深刻的见解。

sentences.en: The first of all dreams speaks of an empty temple.
sentences.zh: 所有梦境的开端，都指向一座空旷的神庙。

sentences.en: Loss precedes presence, and every image must abide by this rule.
sentences.zh: 失去先于存在，每一个意象都必须遵循这一法则。

sentences.en: Think about what Aduduri was experiencing.
sentences.zh: 想想阿杜杜里当时正在经历什么。

sentences.en: She walks into a space that should be full of meaning, full of the containers that hold her culture's understanding of itself, and they are gone.
sentences.zh: 她走进了一个本该充满意义的空间，一个装满了她的文化对自身理解的容器的空间，而它们却消失了。

sentences.en: The gods have been dragged away, and all that she can do is weep.
sentences.zh: 神灵被拖走了，她所能做的只有痛哭。

sentences.en: This is the thesis of this entire series.
sentences.zh: 这就是我们整个系列的中心论点。

sentences.en: What happens when you strip context from consciousness?
sentences.zh: 当你剥离意识的语境时会发生什么？

sentences.en: What happens when you take away the metaphors that allow us to function, to project ourselves onto something larger than ourselves, to make sense of existence?
sentences.zh: 当你抽离了那些让我们得以运转、让我们将自我投射到比自身更宏大的事物上、让我们理解生存意义的隐喻时，会发生什么？

sentences.en: What Aduduri experiences in that empty temple is something very close to madness.
sentences.zh: 阿杜杜里在那座空神庙里经历的，正是非常接近疯狂的一种状态。

sentences.en: A retreat entirely into the subjective is insane, and this person who believes that their feelings are reality, who can't distinguish between what they imagine and what is.
sentences.zh: 完全退守到主观之中是疯狂的，这种人认为自己的感觉就是现实，分不清什么是想象，什么是现实。

sentences.en: This is psychosis in its clinical sense.
sentences.zh: 这是临床意义上的精神病。

sentences.en: Someone who is so lost in the inner world that they've lost contact with a shared world that could encounter another person.
sentences.zh: 有的人迷失在内心世界中，以至于失去了与能够接触他人的共享世界的联系。

sentences.en: They are alone.
sentences.zh: 他们是孤立的。

sentences.en: But a retreat entirely into the objective is also insane, and this is the person who believes only what can be counted as real,
sentences.zh: 但完全退守到客观之中同样是疯狂的，这种人只相信能够被量化为现实的事物，

sentences.en: who can't access their own felt experience, who is trying to be what everyone needs them to be, and forgot who they were.
sentences.zh: 他们无法触及自己真实的情感体验，试图成为所有人需要他们成为的样子，却忘记了自己是谁。

sentences.en: Someone so lost in measurement and abstraction that they've lost contact with lived reality, and they are also isolated, alone, and stripped of context.
sentences.zh: 有的人迷失在测量和抽象中，以至于失去了与生活现实的联系，他们同样被孤立、孤独，且被剥夺了语境。

sentences.en: Both are forms of the same dissolution, and both are failures to maintain the bridge between the inner and the outer world.
sentences.zh: 两者都是同一种解体的形式，都是未能维持内外部世界之间桥梁的失败。

sentences.en: Sanity is the capacity to move between the subjective and the objective, to hold them in tension, and to use each to check the other.
sentences.zh: 理智是在主观和客观之间游走的能力，是保持两者张力、并用各自去检验彼此的能力。

sentences.en: Sanity is a metaphor.
sentences.zh: 理智是一个隐喻。

sentences.en: Sanity is a symbol.
sentences.zh: 理智是一个符号。

sentences.en: Sanity is the ability to stand in the temple and know that the statue is not the god, but also know that the statue matters, that it points to one.
sentences.zh: 理智是这样一种能力：站在神庙中，既知道雕像并非神明本身，又知道雕像至关重要，它指向神明。

sentences.en: And we built a temple, you know, a mental health system that pushes people towards the objectivity that is driving us insane while claiming to cure them of this objective.
sentences.zh: 而我们建造了一座神庙，你知道的，一个把人们推向客观性、却又号称要治愈这种客观性所导致的疯狂的精神健康系统。

sentences.en: And we've emptied the temple and called it treatment.
sentences.zh: 我们搬空了神庙，并称之为治疗。

sentences.en: Welcome to the Taproot Therapy podcast and Discover Heal Grow.
sentences.zh: 欢迎收听 Taproot Therapy 播客的《探索、治愈、成长》栏目。

sentences.en: This is Troll Blackstock, and this concludes our series on the DSM and the quantification of consciousness.
sentences.zh: 我是特罗尔·布莱克斯托克，本期关于 DSM 和意识量化的系列节目到此结束。

sentences.en: The historian that I talk about a lot, Theodore Porter, wrote a book called Trust in Numbers, and that explains exactly how this happened.
sentences.zh: 我经常提及的历史学家西奥多·波特写过一本书叫《信赖数字》，这本书准确地解释了这一切是如何发生的。

sentences.en: You know, Porter makes this distinction that's crucial.
sentences.zh: 你知道，波特做出了一个至关重要的区分。

sentences.en: He separates disciplinary objectivity from mechanical objectivity.
sentences.zh: 他将纪律客观性与机械客观性区分开来。

sentences.en: Disciplinary objectivity is what works in high trust communities.
sentences.zh: 纪律客观性适用于高度信任的社群。

sentences.en: It relies on trained judgment, experts who share a tacit understanding of what constitutes valid knowledge, and they don't need a checklist to agree on what they see.
sentences.zh: 它依赖于训练有素的判断力，依赖于对什么是有效知识有着默契理解的专家，他们不需要核对清单就能对看到的事物达成共识。

sentences.en: Their shared training and socialization provides the standard, and this is how psychoanalysis used to work.
sentences.zh: 他们共同的培训和社交化过程提供了标准，精神分析过去就是这样运作的。

sentences.en: The authority of the analyst was personal.
sentences.zh: 分析师的权威是个人化的。

sentences.en: It came from training lineage, clinical experience, reputation within the guild.
sentences.zh: 它源于培训渊源、临床经验以及在同行中的声誉。

sentences.en: Mechanical objectivity is different.
sentences.zh: 机械客观性则不同。

sentences.en: Rigid adherence to explicit rules, algorithms, standardized protocols.
sentences.zh: 它严格遵守显性规则、算法和标准化协议。

sentences.en: It tries to eliminate what
sentences.zh: 它试图消除波特所谓的

sentences.en: Porter calls the personal equation, the idiosyncrasies of the individual observer, so that any two people following the same rules arrive at the same result.
sentences.zh: 个人方程——即个别观察者的特质，以便任何两个人遵循相同的规则都能得出相同的结论。

sentences.en: Here's Porter's crucial insight.
sentences.zh: 以下是波特的核心见解。

sentences.en: Mechanical objectivity is not pursued by the strongest scientists.
sentences.zh: 追求机械客观性的并非最强大的科学家。

sentences.en: Sciences, it's pursued by the weakest and most insecure forms of science.
sentences.zh: 科学界，它是被最薄弱、最缺乏安全感的科学形式所追求的。

sentences.en: Soft science.
sentences.zh: 软科学。

sentences.en: When a discipline is vulnerable to external criticism, political pressure, or internal fragmentation, it retreats to mechanical objectivity to defend itself against charges of
sentences.zh: 当一门学科容易受到外部批评、政治压力或内部瓦解的影响时，它就会退守到机械客观性，以此来抵御

sentences.en: arbitrariness.
sentences.zh: 专断的指责。

sentences.en: And Porter writes, objectivity lends authority to officials who have very little of their own.
sentences.zh: 正如波特所写：客观性赋予了那些自身几乎没有权威的官员以权威。

sentences.en: And this is not a story about science getting better.
sentences.zh: 这不是一个关于科学变得更好的故事。

sentences.en: It's a story about institutions getting scared.
sentences.zh: 这是一个关于机构变得恐慌的故事。

sentences.en: In the 1970s, psychiatry faced a legitimate crisis.
sentences.zh: 在20世纪70年代，精神病学面临着一场合法的危机。

sentences.en: The Rosenhan studies sent sane people into hospitals that they couldn't tell, you know, whether or not the people were sane.
sentences.zh: 罗森汉实验将神志正常的人送入医院，而医院却无法分辨，你知道的，这些人到底正不正常。

sentences.en: And the anti-psychiatry movement called psychiatry a tool of social control.
sentences.zh: 反精神病学运动将精神病学称作社会控制的工具。

sentences.en: Insurance companies demanded accountability, the same that they would have for pills or surgery.
sentences.zh: 保险公司要求问责，就像对待药丸或手术那样。

sentences.en: And the response was the DSM-3.
sentences.zh: 而应对之策就是《精神障碍诊断与统计手册第三版》（DSM-3）。

sentences.en: They purged the etiology of the theory, you know, and all of the contentious stuff about what causes mental illness.
sentences.zh: 他们剔除了理论的病因学，你知道的，以及所有关于精神疾病成因的争议性内容。

sentences.en: And they replaced it with symptom checklists.
sentences.zh: 并用症状检查表取而代之。

sentences.en: Must have five of the following nine for at least two weeks.
sentences.zh: 必须在至少两周内符合以下九项中的五项。

sentences.en: And the goal was reliability.
sentences.zh: 其目标是信度。

sentences.en: If two psychiatrists saw the same patient, they should arrive at the same diagnosis.
sentences.zh: 如果两个精神科医生看到同一个病人，他们应该得出相同的诊断。

sentences.en: But this was not discovering disease entities.
sentences.zh: 但这并不是在发现疾病实体。

sentences.en: It was a bureaucratic fortification.
sentences.zh: 这是一种官僚主义的筑垒防守。

sentences.en: By creating a rigid manual, psychiatry insulated itself from the charge of subjectivity.
sentences.zh: 通过制定一本死板的手册，精神病学将自己与主观性的指责隔离开来。

sentences.en: It allowed the profession to interfere or interface with the insurance companies and not be interfered with at a judgment-based level by insurance and the FDA.
sentences.zh: 它让这一专业得以与保险公司对接并进行交互，而不会在基于判断的层面上受到保险公司和美国食品药品监督管理局（FDA）的干涉。

sentences.en: The manual became a technology of truSt. Not a trust in a doctor, but a trust in a code.
sentences.zh: 这本手册变成了一种信任的技术。不是对医生的信任，而是对规范的信任。

sentences.en: And here's the strategy, you know, that Porter would say illuminates the trade-off between reality.
sentences.zh: 这就是波特所说的阐明现实之间权衡的策略。

sentences.en: He would say that there's a trade-off between reliability and validity.
sentences.zh: 他会说，信度和效度之间存在着一种权衡。

sentences.en: Reliability is consistency.
sentences.zh: 信度是一致性。

sentences.en: We all agree that this is major depressive disorder.
sentences.zh: 我们都同意这是重度抑郁症。

sentences.en: Validity is truth.
sentences.zh: 效度是真实性。

sentences.en: And this label actually corresponds to something real.
sentences.zh: 这个标签确实对应着某种真实存在的事物。

sentences.en: You can have one without the other.
sentences.zh: 你可以鱼与熊掌取其一，或者二者缺一。

sentences.en: But in pursuing reliability, psychiatry sacrificed validity.
sentences.zh: 但在追求信度的过程中，精神病学牺牲了效度。

sentences.en: And the categories became socially valid.
sentences.zh: 这些分类在社会层面上变得有效了。

sentences.en: Insurance insurers accepted them, but biologically invalid.
sentences.zh: 保险公司接受了它们，但在生物学上却是无效的。

sentences.en: They don't carve nature at its joints.
sentences.zh: 它们并未顺应大自然的纹理来剖析事物。

sentences.en: In 2013, the National Institute of Mental Health declared that the DSM was scientifically invalid.
sentences.zh: 2013年，美国国家心理健康研究所宣布DSM在科学上是无效的。

sentences.en: But nothing changed clinically because the DSM's purpose was never scientific validity.
sentences.zh: 但临床上什么都没有改变，因为DSM的目的从来都不是科学有效性。

sentences.en: It was bureaucratic legitimacy.
sentences.zh: 而是官僚主义的合法性。

sentences.en: And they emptied the temple to survive.
sentences.zh: 为了生存，他们搬空了神庙。

sentences.en: Now, here's a big point to understand.
sentences.zh: 现在，这里有一个需要理解的重大观点。

sentences.en: You know, it's easy to hear all this and think that I'm describing a conspiracy, but I'm not.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，听到这一切很容易让人觉得我是在描述一场阴谋，但我并没有。

sentences.en: Most people in the system aren't villains.
sentences.zh: 体制内的大多数人并不是恶人。

sentences.en: They're not consciously hiding biases for profit.
sentences.zh: 他们并非为了利益而刻意隐瞒偏见。

sentences.en: The insurance executives, the academics, the researchers, the clinicians following protocols, most of them genuinely believe that they're being rigorous.
sentences.zh: 保险高管、学者、研究人员、遵循规程的临床医生，他们中的大多数人真心相信自己是在严谨行事。

sentences.en: The genuine belief, they genuinely believe that they are being scientific.
sentences.zh: 这种真诚的信念，他们真心相信自己很科学。

sentences.en: And that's what makes this tragic instead of merely corrupt.
sentences.zh: 正是这一点让这一切变得充满悲剧色彩，而不仅仅是腐败。

sentences.en: They've lost faith in what they can't see.
sentences.zh: 他们对看不见的东西失去了信念。

sentences.en: Think about what it means to trust trained judgment.
sentences.zh: 想想信赖经过训练的判断力意味着什么。

sentences.en: It means believing that a person through years of formation and experience can perceive truths that can't be reduced to a checkliSt.
sentences.zh: 这意味着相信一个人通过多年的塑造和经验，能够感知到无法被简化为检查表的真理。

sentences.en: It means believing in something invisible, the cultivation of wisdom, the development of clinical intuition, the ineffable quality of the therapeutic presence.
sentences.zh: 这意味着相信某种看不见的事物：智慧的培养、临床直觉的发展、治疗陪伴那不可言喻的品质。

sentences.en: That requires faith, faith in human capacity, faith in the intangible.
sentences.zh: 这需要信念，对人类能力的信念，对无形之物的信念。

sentences.en: And somewhere along the way, that faith broke.
sentences.zh: 而在某个时刻，这种信念破灭了。

sentences.en: When you lose faith in the invisible, you don't stop believing in it.
sentences.zh: 当你对看不见的事物失去信念时，你并未停止相信它。

sentences.en: You transfer your faith to whatever is visible.
sentences.zh: 你将你的信念转移到了任何看得见的事物上。

sentences.en: And so the PHQ-9 score becomes more real than the patient's suffering, or the story that the patient is telling, and the diagnostic code becomes more real than the person.
sentences.zh: 因此，PHQ-9（患者健康问卷）的得分比病人的痛苦，或者病人正在讲述的故事变得更真实，诊断代码也比人本身更真实。

sentences.en: The randomized controlled trial becomes more real than what happens in the room.
sentences.zh: 随机对照试验比治疗室里发生的事情更真实。

sentences.en: And the system becomes more than reality itself.
sentences.zh: 这个系统变得比现实本身更真实。

sentences.en: And this isn't corruption.
sentences.zh: 这不是腐败。

sentences.en: It's a civilizational loss of faith in the invisible.
sentences.zh: 这是文明层面上对无形之物信仰的丧失。

sentences.en: And the people inside the system can't see their own assumptions anymore because they've dressed them in the costume of objectivity.
sentences.zh: 体制内的人再也无法看清他们自己的假设了，因为他们给这些假设披上了客观性的外衣。

sentences.en: And the blind spots fill up.
sentences.zh: 盲区越来越大。

sentences.en: We can't see them.
sentences.zh: 我们看不见它们。

sentences.en: So we think that we can see everything because we can't see what we can't see.
sentences.zh: 所以我们以为自己能看到一切，因为我们看不见自己所看不见的。

sentences.en: And this pattern shows up throughout history when civilizations lose faith in the invisible.
sentences.zh: 当文明对无形之物失去信仰时，这种模式就会在历史上反复上演。

sentences.en: You know, late in Rome, they maintained elaborate bureaucratic forms long after the substance was gone.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，在罗马帝国后期，当实质内容早已不复存在时，他们依然维持着繁琐的官僚形式。

sentences.en: The offices still had titles.
sentences.zh: 职位仍然保留着头衔。

sentences.en: The procedures still had steps.
sentences.zh: 程序仍然有着步骤。

sentences.en: The forms got filled out.
sentences.zh: 表格照常填写。

sentences.en: But the meaning behind them evaporated.
sentences.zh: 但背后的意义却烟消云散了。

sentences.en: They kept the forms because the forms were visible and the substance required faith that they no longer had in an empire that had fallen.
sentences.zh: 他们保留这些形式，是因为形式是看得见的，而实质则需要他们在一个已经没落的帝国中早已不复存在的信念。

sentences.en: You know, the Soviet Union knew that the five-year plan had these quotas and there were lies.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，苏联明知五年计划有这些配额，而且存在谎言。

sentences.en: Everyone knew that.
sentences.zh: 所有人都心知肚明。

sentences.en: The factory managers knew.
sentences.zh: 工厂经理心知肚明。

sentences.en: The party officials knew.
sentences.zh: 党政官员心知肚明。

sentences.en: The workers knew.
sentences.zh: 工人们心知肚明。

sentences.en: But they maintained the quotas, falsified the reports, performed the rituals of productivity because the alternative was admitting that there was nothing underneath.
sentences.zh: 但他们依然维持着配额，伪造报告，走着生产的仪式过场，因为唯一的选择就是承认底层空无一物。

sentences.en: The numbers had become more real than reality.
sentences.zh: 数字变得比现实更真实。

sentences.en: And dismantling them would expose the void.
sentences.zh: 而拆除它们将暴露这片虚空。

sentences.en: And then there's cargo cults.
sentences.zh: 还有货物崇拜。

sentences.en: You know, during the World War II, American troops landed on islands in the South Pacific.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，在二战期间，美军登陆了南太平洋的岛屿。

sentences.en: Melanesia,
sentences.zh: 美拉尼西亚，

sentences.en: Vanuatu.
sentences.zh: 瓦努阿图。

sentences.en: I'm not sure how to say that one.
sentences.zh: 我不太确定那个词怎么发音。

sentences.en: I think it's Vanuatu.
sentences.zh: 我想是瓦努阿图。

sentences.en: Places that had never seen, you know, industrial civilization.
sentences.zh: 这些地方从未见过，你知道的，工业文明。

sentences.en: They built airstrips.
sentences.zh: 他们修建了简易机场。

sentences.en: They set up radio towers.
sentences.zh: 他们架设了无线电塔。

sentences.en: And when the planes landed, they brought cargo, food, medicine, chocolate, Coca-Cola.
sentences.zh: 当飞机降落时，带来了货物、食物、药品、巧克力、可口可乐。

sentences.en: And these islanders had never seen any of this stuff.
sentences.zh: 而这些岛民从未见过这些东西。

sentences.en: And the soldiers were generous.
sentences.zh: 士兵们很慷慨。

sentences.en: They'd share what they had when the plane landed with the supplies.
sentences.zh: 飞机载着补给降落时，他们会分享自己拥有的东西。

sentences.en: And the islanders watched everything.
sentences.zh: 岛民们在一旁观察着一切。

sentences.en: And they watched the men sit in the huts with little pieces on their head.
sentences.zh: 他们看着这些男人坐在棚屋里，头上戴着小物件。

sentences.en: And they watched them talk into boxes, you know, headphones and radios.
sentences.zh: 他们看着他们对着盒子讲话，你知道的，就是耳机和收音机。

sentences.en: And they watched them spin cranks and wave flags.

sentences.en: And then the planes would come.

sentences.zh: 接着战争结束了。

sentences.zh: 士兵们离开了。

sentences.zh: 于是货物不再运来。

sentences.en: When the anthropologists went back years later, they found the islanders had built their own airstrip.
sentences.zh: 多年后，当人类学家重返那里时，他们发现岛民们自己修建了简易机场。

sentences.en: They'd cleared the jungle and made runways.
sentences.zh: 他们砍伐丛林，修建了跑道。

sentences.en: And they'd built wooden control towers.
sentences.zh: 他们用木头搭建了控制塔。

sentences.en: And they'd carved headphones out of coconut shells.
sentences.zh: 他们用椰子壳雕刻了耳机。

sentences.en: And they'd made antennas out of bamboo.
sentences.zh: 他们用竹子制作了天线。

sentences.en: And they sat in their huts.
sentences.zh: 他们坐在棚屋里。

sentences.en: And they talked to rocks.
sentences.zh: 他们对着石头说话。

sentences.en: And they waved landing signals at the empty sky.
sentences.zh: 他们向空无一人的天空挥舞着着陆信号。

sentences.en: And Richard Feynman, the physicist, gave a commencement speech at Caltech in 1974.
sentences.zh: 物理学家理查德·费曼于1974年在加州理工学院发表了一场毕业典礼演讲。

sentences.en: He said, in the South Seas, there is a cargo cult of people.
sentences.zh: 他说，在南海，有一个崇拜货物的社群。

sentences.en: And during the war, they saw airplanes land with a good, with lots of goods and materials.
sentences.zh: 在战争期间，他们看到飞机降落，运来了大量的好东西和物资。

sentences.en: And they wanted the same thing to happen now.
sentences.zh: 现在他们也希望发生同样的事情。

sentences.en: So they've arranged to make things like runways, to put fires along the sides of the runways, to make a wooden hut for a man to sit in with two wooden pieces on his
sentences.zh: 于是他们开始制作类似跑道的东西，在跑道两侧生起篝火，为一个人制作木屋让他坐在里面，头上戴着两个木制部件

sentences.en: head, like a headphone, and bars of bamboo sticks sticking out like antennas.
sentences.zh: 就像耳机一样，还有像天线一样伸出来的竹条。

sentences.en: He's the controller.
sentences.zh: 他就是管制员。

sentences.en: And they wait for the airplanes to land.
sentences.zh: 然后他们等待飞机降落。

sentences.en: They're doing everything right.
sentences.zh: 他们把一切都做得对极了。

sentences.en: The form is perfect.
sentences.zh: 形式完美无缺。

sentences.en: It looks exactly the way that it should, the way that it looked before.
sentences.zh: 它看起来完全应该是那个样子，也就是以前看过的样子。

sentences.en: But it doesn't work, because no airplanes land.
sentences.zh: 但它不管用，因为没有飞机降落。

sentences.en: And Feynman called this the cargo cult science, following all the apparent forms of scientific investigation, while missing something essential.
sentences.zh: 费曼将此称为货轮崇拜科学，即遵循科学研究的所有表面形式，却忽略了至关重要的东西。

sentences.en: He was talking about psychology.
sentences.zh: 他当时谈论的是心理学。

sentences.zh: 他说，首要原则是你绝不能欺骗自己。

sentences.zh: 而你自己又是最容易被骗的人。

sentences.en: Never underestimate how a little group of people who think that they're smart and take themselves very seriously can actually know.
sentences.zh: 千万不要低估一小群自以为聪明且极度自负的人实际上能懂多少。

sentences.en: When I was a kid, there was this guy who has this, he was huge in evangelical circles, James Dobson, focused on the family.
sentences.zh: 当我还是个孩子的时候，有这么一个人，他在福音派圈子里名气极大地影响着家庭，詹姆斯·多布森。

sentences.en: And he did all these books and seminars about raising children to be Christian and accountable.
sentences.zh: 他写了许多书并举办了各种研讨会，关于如何把孩子培养成有基督信仰且负责任的人。

sentences.en: And the motto of the movement was break the will of the child.
sentences.zh: 该运动的座右铭就是摧毁孩子的意志。

sentences.en: You know, the child was bad.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，小孩子都是坏的。

sentences.en: And if you made it subservient, you know, it was how could the child serve the God if they can't even serve the father.
sentences.zh: 如果你让他们顺从，你知道的，如果他们连父亲都伺候不好，又怎么能去伺候上帝呢。

sentences.en: So you teach them obedience through discipline.
sentences.zh: 所以你要通过纪律来教导他们顺从。

sentences.en: And Dobson advocated for spanking children as young as 15 months old.
sentences.zh: 多布森甚至主张对仅15个月大的幼儿实施体罚。

sentences.en: And he wrote about escalating punishment until there was crying, genuine tears, is what he would call it, not pretend tears.
sentences.zh: 他写到要不断升级惩罚，直到孩子哭出声来，也就是他所说的真正的眼泪，而不是假装的眼泪。

sentences.en: They have to actually be completely dysregulated.
sentences.zh: 他们必须彻底情绪失控才行。

sentences.en: And, you know, there was a thing
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道的，还有一件事

sentences.en: that he also would say was that if the baby was crying, but it wasn't mealtime, an infant, you should give it water to show that you heard it.
sentences.zh: 他也经常说，如果婴儿在哭闹，但又不是喂食时间，对于一个婴儿，你应该给它水喝以表示你听到了它的哭声。

sentences.en: But you, you shouldn't give it milk because it wasn't mealtime.
sentences.zh: 但是你，你不应该给它牛奶，因为那不是喂食时间。

sentences.en: And you were trying to teach it that it was crying at the wrong time.
sentences.zh: 你试图教导它，它哭泣的时间不对。

sentences.en: You know,
sentences.zh: 你知道的，

sentences.en: we know infants, they need food.
sentences.zh: 我们都知道婴儿需要食物。

sentences.en: They don't even know that they're separate from the mother.
sentences.zh: 他们甚至不知道自己是独立于母亲的个体。

sentences.en: They just want warmth and love and food.
sentences.zh: 他们只想要温暖、爱和食物。

sentences.en: You know, and Dobson says, when your baby cries, just give it water to show it that it's not controlling you.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，多布森却说，当你的婴儿哭泣时，只给它水喝，向它证明它并没有控制你。

sentences.en: You know, it's an ego battle with a creature that doesn't have an ego.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，这是在和一个根本没有自我意识的生物进行一场自我较量。

sentences.en: Like a dog knows how to nurse its babies.
sentences.zh: 就像狗懂得如何哺乳它们的幼崽一样。

sentences.en: And we get a whole bunch of people in a room who sat down completely objectively through logic and ego came up with a way to break that inborn nature and to be cut off from it.
sentences.zh: 而我们却让一整群人坐在一间屋子里，完全客观地通过逻辑和自我意识，想出了一种方法来摧毁那种与生俱来的天性并将其切断。

sentences.en: There's a metaphor from visual science, neuroscience that explains why people inside the systems generally can't see what they're doing.
sentences.zh: 视觉科学、神经科学中有一个比喻，解释了为什么身处系统内部的人通常看不到自己在做什么。

sentences.en: The lacuna is the spot in your eye where the optic nerve enters the eye to carry the message back to the subcortical brain or 90% of it.
sentences.zh: 生理盲点就是你眼中的那个位置，视神经在那里进入眼睛，将信息传回皮层下脑，或者说其中90%的信息。

sentences.en: And then 10% goes directly.
sentences.zh: 然后10%直接传输。

sentences.en: And the rest of it goes to occipital where an image gets resolved.
sentences.zh: 其余的则传到枕叶，在那里图像被解析出来。

sentences.en: And the eye is literally blind there.
sentences.zh: 而眼睛在那里确实是盲的。

sentences.en: You can't see anything.
sentences.zh: 你什么也看不见。

sentences.en: There's a hole in your vision right now, but your brain confabulates vision in that spot.
sentences.zh: 此刻你的视野中有一个漏洞，但你的大脑会在那个位置捏造出视觉。

sentences.en: It takes everything around the blind spot.
sentences.zh: 它获取盲点周围的一切。

sentences.en: It fills it in like a Photoshop filter.
sentences.zh: 像Photoshop滤镜一样把它填满。

sentences.en: And you can't see that.
sentences.zh: 而你根本察觉不到这一点。

sentences.en: Even if you try, the confabulation is seamless.
sentences.zh: 即使你试图寻找，这种捏造也是天衣无缝的。

sentences.en: You can look at the center of your vision and you have no idea where it is.
sentences.zh: 你可以看着视野的中心，却完全不知道盲点在哪里。

sentences.en: And this is what institutions do.
sentences.zh: 这就是各种机构所做的事情。

sentences.en: They fill in their blind spots with assumptions, assumptions dressed as facts.
sentences.zh: 它们用假设来填补盲点，将假设伪装成事实。

sentences.en: The pharmaceutical researcher doesn't see their funding source as bias because they've defined methodology in a way that excludes that consideration.
sentences.zh: 制药研究人员并不认为他们的资金来源是一种偏见，因为他们对方法的定义已经排除了这种考量。

sentences.en: The blind spot fills itself in.
sentences.zh: 盲点会自动填满。

sentences.en: The academic doesn't see their career investment as bias because they've defined evidence in a way that only includes certain evidence and excludes others.
sentences.zh: 学术人员并不认为他们的职业投资是一种偏见，因为他们对证据的定义只包含某些证据而排除了其他证据。

sentences.en: So it's not evidence.
sentences.zh: 所以这就不是证据。

sentences.en: I'm not going to look at it, except it's evidence that you're wrong.
sentences.zh: 我才不看它呢，除非它是证明你错了的证据。

sentences.en: You're just not looking at it.
sentences.zh: 你只是不去看它罢了。

sentences.en: And they look at certain evidence very correctly and the blind spot fills up.
sentences.zh: 他们对某些证据的观察非常正确，于是盲点就被填满了。

sentences.en: And the insurance company doesn't see the profit motive as bias because they've defined responsible care in a way that aligns with their bottom line.
sentences.zh: 保险公司并不认为追求利润是一种偏见，因为他们对负责任的护理的定义与他们的底线相吻合。

sentences.en: And the ultimate purpose of their organization is to make money.
sentences.zh: 而他们组织终极的目的就是赚钱。

sentences.en: So how could they examine that?
sentences.zh: 所以他们怎么可能会去审视这一点呢？

sentences.en: The blind spot fills up.
sentences.zh: 盲点被填满了。

sentences.en: They genuinely can't see it.
sentences.zh: 他们确实完全看不见。

sentences.en: The lacuna is invisible to the eye that has it and all eyes have it.
sentences.zh: 盲点对于拥有它的人的眼睛来说是隐形的，而所有眼睛都有盲点。

sentences.en: And this is why the system can't reform itself from within.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么这个系统无法从内部进行自我改革的原因。

sentences.en: The people inside are looking through eyes that have blind spots in exactly the same places that they'd need to see to make change.
sentences.zh: 身处其中的人们所透过其观察的眼睛，其盲点恰好位于他们为了做出改变而必须看清的地方。

sentences.en: And they're performing the rituals of science with genuine sincerity.
sentences.zh: 他们怀着无比的真诚在履行科学的仪式。

sentences.en: And they never notice that the substance has been replaced by procedure.
sentences.zh: 却从未注意到实质内容早已被程序所取代。

sentences.en: And the only way to see a blind spot is through another perspective.
sentences.zh: 而看清盲点的唯一方法就是通过另一种视角。

sentences.en: Multiple eyes can map the visual field completely, even though no single eye can see everything, which is why this conversation has to happen outside of that system.
sentences.zh: 多双眼睛可以完整地绘制出视野图，尽管没有单只眼睛能看清一切，这就是为什么这场对话必须在那个系统之外发生。

sentences.en: You know, here's what actually works in therapy, what's always worked, what keeps getting discovered over and over across cultures and centuries by people who never met each other.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，以下是疗法中真正管用的方法，一直以来都管用，被那些素未谋面的人跨越文化和世纪一遍又一遍地发现的方法。

sentences.en: These are perennial philosophies.
sentences.zh: 这些就是永恒的哲学。

sentences.en: They recur because they're pointing at something true about consciousness itself.
sentences.zh: 它们不断重现，是因为它们指出了关于意识本身的某种真实存在。

sentences.en: If this weren't a story that the deep brain is telling us from behind the scenes, then we wouldn't keep rediscovering it.
sentences.zh: 如果这不是深层大脑在幕后向我们诉说的一个故事，我们就不会不断重新发现它。

sentences.en: That is a recurrent form of evidence, objective evidence, but it requires your subjectivity to see what these people are saying.
sentences.zh: 这是一种反复出现的证据形式，是客观证据，但它需要你的主观性去理解这些人到底在说什么。

sentences.en: And it's evidence that can't be seen from the distance of pure objectivity.
sentences.zh: 而且这种证据是无法从纯粹客观的距离中看清的。

sentences.en: The problem is that different traditions aren't using the same language.
sentences.zh: 问题在于不同的传统并没有使用相同的语言。

sentences.en: And they're not all saying, here's the Sudskora invented in ancient Babylon, and then Carl Jung invented it in his study.
sentences.zh: 它们并不都在说：看，这是古代巴比伦发明的苏德斯科拉，然后卡尔·荣格在他的书房里又发明了它。

sentences.en: They're describing subjective spaces phenomenologically through metaphor.
sentences.zh: 它们是在通过隐喻，以现象学的方式描述主观空间。

sentences.en: But when they do that, if you can't read metaphor, if you can't see it, which I'm arguing we are losing the capacity to do rapidly, then you can, you can't see that
sentences.zh: 但当它们这么做时，如果你无法读懂隐喻，如果你看不透它，而我认为我们正在迅速失去这种能力，那么你就，你就无法看出

sentences.en: they're talking about the same phenomena.
sentences.zh: 它们其实在谈论相同的现象。

sentences.en: Plato was already saying these things.
sentences.zh: 柏拉图当时就已经在说这些事情了。

sentences.en: Competing drives, multiplicity, the need for integration, the importance of knowing myself, the allegory of the
sentences.zh: 相互竞争的驱力、多元性、整合的需求、了解自我的重要性，以及洞穴

sentences.en: cave, which is basically just a description of how unconscious assumptions shape our perception.
sentences.zh: 寓言，这基本上只是对无意识的假设如何塑造我们的感知的一种描述。

sentences.en: And we act like every new therapeutic modality in this system is completely separate.
sentences.zh: 而我们的表现却好像这个系统中的每一种新疗法都是完全独立的。

sentences.en: And in this invention that came out of nowhere, they came out of a lab stripped of context or any history, but the parts that work have always been doing these things.
sentences.zh: 在这个凭空出现、脱离了实验室、剥离了上下文或任何历史的发明中，只有那些管用的部分其实一直都在做这些事情。

sentences.en: Therapy did not invent therapy.
sentences.zh: 疗法并不是疗法发明的。

sentences.en: It's always been with us.
sentences.zh: 它一直都伴随着我们。

sentences.en: You know, first metacognition, getting outside your head, developing the capacity to observe your own mental processes, rather than identifying with one
sentences.zh: 你知道的，首先是元认知，跳出你的思维局限，培养出观察自己心理过程的能力，而不是认同你所感受到的某一个

sentences.zh: 单一部分，学会它只是你的一部分的一部分。

sentences.en: And this is meditation.
sentences.zh: 这就是冥想。

sentences.en: This is mindfulness.
sentences.zh: 这就是正念。

sentences.en: This is Freud's where it was, their ego shall be.
sentences.zh: 这就是弗洛伊德所谓的“力比多在哪里，自我就在哪里”。

sentences.en: This is
sentences.zh: 这就是

sentences.en: Jung's individuation.
sentences.zh: 荣格的个性化过程。

sentences.en: This is CBT's cognitive restructuring when it works, all pointing at the same thing.
sentences.zh: 这就是认知行为疗法（CBT）发挥作用时的认知重构，它们都指向了同一件事。

sentences.en: But in a purely cognitive behavioral vacuum, it's hard to do metacognition if you don't understand multiplicity of parts, because you're thinking I'm one thing thinking this thing.
sentences.zh: 但在一个纯粹的认知行为真空里，如果你不理解部分的多元性，就很难做到元认知，因为你会认为我是一个在思考这件事情的整体。

sentences.zh: 那么，我该如何改变这一点？

sentences.zh: 当你完全沉浸于自我之中时，你是无法从自己身上抽离出来的。

sentences.en: The brain has competing networks of consciousness, and it's not one monad.
sentences.zh: 大脑拥有相互竞争的意识网络，它不是一个单一的单子。

sentences.en: There are different systems with different agendas, and you need a framework to discover that.
sentences.zh: 存在着具有不同议程的不同系统，你需要一个框架来发现这一点。

sentences.en: Second, semantics, the way the body stores energy and emotion, and pre-budgets it in anticipation of what you need to feel to solve a problem later, based on subtle clues.

sentences.zh: 尽管他到了晚年变得多么疯狂，你知道的，他在这一点上并没有错。

sentences.zh: 这就是珀尔斯的身体觉察。

sentences.zh: 这就是莱文的，你知道的，躯体体验。

sentences.zh: 这就是波格斯的多元迷走神经理论。

sentences.zh: 身体铭记一切，

sentences.en: Vanderkolk.
sentences.zh: 范德科尔克。

sentences.en: and making you a collaborator in that project because there is no formula for meaning.
sentences.zh: 并让你成为该项目标的合作者，因为意义是没有固定公式的。

sentences.en: And that's the point.
sentences.zh: 这就是关键所在。

sentences.en: You know, my wife's a teacher and one of the things that drives me nuts is how we'll spend,
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我妻子是一名老师，有一件事让我抓狂，那就是我们作为一个国家会花费

sentences.en: I understand wanting to burn it all down, but the corruption goes deeper than capitalism, deeper than big pharma, deeper than the DSM.
sentences.zh: 我能理解想要把这一切付之一炬的想法，但这种腐败比资本主义更深，比大型制药公司更深，比 DSM（精神疾病诊断与统计手册）更深。

sentences.en: It's invaded your assumptions.
sentences.zh: 它已经侵入了你的底层假设。

sentences.en: That's my point.
sentences.zh: 这就是我的观点。

sentences.en: Yours and mine, the way you think about health, the way you think about self, the way you imagine what healing means.
sentences.zh: 你和我的观点，你对健康的看法，你对自我的看法，你对疗愈意义的想象。

sentences.en: That's been colonized.
sentences.zh: 这些都已经被殖民了。

sentences.en: We all inhabit mythology and we all have a temple full of idol, whether or not we admit that they're there.
sentences.zh: 我们都生活在神话中，我们的神庙里也都充满了偶像，不管我们是否承认它们的存在。

sentences.en: And here's what colonization does.
sentences.zh: 这就是殖民带来的后果。

sentences.en: It strips you of the creativity to envision something better.
sentences.zh: 它剥夺了你构想更好事物的创造力。

sentences.en: It makes you think that the only options are a corrupt system or do it yourself.
sentences.zh: 它让你觉得唯一的选择要么是一个腐败的系统，要么就自己单干。

sentences.en: And it forecloses the possibility that care could be a right, that institutions could serve humanity again, that we could take control of them.
sentences.zh: 它排除了这样一种可能性：关怀可以是一项权利，机构可以重新为人类服务，我们可以掌控它们。

sentences.en: The people who say, you know, just use crystals or, you know, find your tribe or Joe Rogan has a supplement.
sentences.zh: 那些说，你知道的，只要用水晶，或者，你知道的，找到你的社群，或者乔丹·罗根有个保健品的人。

sentences.en: That's a spiritual bypass.
sentences.zh: 那是精神绕径（spiritual bypass）。

sentences.en: It's not treatment.
sentences.zh: 那不是治疗。

sentences.en: It's giving you this false empowerment.
sentences.zh: 那是在给你一种虚假的赋权感。

sentences.en: It feels liberating, but it's not real.
sentences.zh: 它感觉很解放，但那不是真的。

sentences.en: And because when these things get really bad, you know,
sentences.zh: 因为当这些事情变得非常糟糕时，你知道的，

sentences.en: you're going to want somebody who's a real licensed provider who can work within the objective metrics
sentences.zh: 你会需要一个真正的持证从业者，他既能在系统的客观指标内工作，

sentences.en: of the system, but also has somehow saved the subjectivity that the system wanted to drag out.
sentences.zh: 但同时又不知何故保留了系统想要强行抹去的主观性。

sentences.en: You know, care is a right, not a privilege.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，关怀是一项权利，而不是特权。

sentences.en: And it's not a product.
sentences.zh: 它不是一件产品。

sentences.en: It's a right.
sentences.zh: 它是一项权利。

sentences.en: And rights require institutions to guarantee them.
sentences.zh: 而权利需要机构来作保障。

sentences.en: Even when those institutions have fallen very far from what they were supposed to be.
sentences.zh: 即使这些机构已经远远偏离了它们原本应有的样子。

sentences.en: And the idols are breaking and the image comes rushing back.
sentences.zh: 当偶像崩塌时，意象便汹涌回归。

sentences.en: And we can only learn to hold the awareness of the absence together.
sentences.zh: 我们唯有学会共同去承担对这种“缺席”的觉知。

sentences.en: Adeduri wept because she was alone in that temple and we don't have to be alone.
sentences.zh: 阿杜杜里之所以哭泣，是因为她在神庙里感到了孤单，而我们不必孤单。

sentences.en: The people in the system aren't evil.
sentences.zh: 系统里的人并不邪恶。

sentences.en: They're scared and they've lost faith in what they can't see.
sentences.zh: 他们只是感到害怕，并对那些看不见的东西失去了信心。

sentences.en: And they built wooden airplanes and performed the rituals and wondered why the cargo doesn't come.
sentences.zh: 于是他们建造了木头飞机，举行了仪式，却纳闷为什么货运飞机还不来。

sentences.en: It's not the forMs. It's not the procedures.
sentences.zh: 问题不在于形式。

sentences.en: It's not the checklist or the metrics or the manualized protocols.
sentences.zh: 不在于流程。

sentences.en: It's the invisible stuff.
sentences.zh: 不在于核对表、指标或照本宣科的方案。

sentences.en: The relationship, the meaning, the presence, the trained judgment, the honed experience of someone who has sat with suffering
sentences.zh: 而在于那些看不见的东西：关系、意义、存在、经过培训的判断力，以及某位曾与痛苦坐在一起并

sentences.en: and learned something that can't be written in a manual.
sentences.zh: 领悟到无法写进手册之物的资深经验。

sentences.en: And Feynman was right.
sentences.zh: 费曼说得对。

sentences.en: The first principle is that you must not fool yourself.
sentences.zh: 首要原则是，你绝不能欺骗自己。

sentences.en: And you are the easiest person to fool.
sentences.zh: 而你又是最容易被自己欺骗的人。

sentences.en: We forgot because we got scared of what couldn't be counted.
sentences.zh: 我们之所以忘记，是因为我们对无法被量化的东西感到恐惧。

sentences.en: And it's time to remember.
sentences.zh: 是时候想起来了。

sentences.en: Stop counting and start to remember the space between numbers.
sentences.zh: 停止计数，开始去回想数字之间的空间。

sentences.en: And notice the distance between you and another person.
sentences.zh: 并注意你与另一个人之间的距离。

sentences.en: That's all we get.
sentences.zh: 这就是我们所拥有的全部。

sentences.en: Adeduri wept because she was alone in the temple.
sentences.zh: 阿德杜里哭了，因为她独自在神庙里。

sentences.en: But we don't have to be.
sentences.zh: 但我们不必如此。
